title: coptophyllum nicobaricum
intro: Coptophyllum nicobaricum, commonly known as Nicobar Island tree, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Coptophyllum nicobaricum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Further research is required to fully understand the bioactive constituents and potential therapeutic applications of this plant.
